variables.name: phone_number
variables.description: Official ElevenLabs batch upload destination-number column. Use E.164 format.
variables.notes: Current ElevenLabs docs require this exact header for dashboard CSV/XLS upload.

variables.name: recipient_number
variables.description: Mirror of phone_number for the Pixelkiez data contract requested by the user.
variables.notes: Keep identical to phone_number. ElevenLabs currently uses phone_number for dialing.

variables.name: campaign_id
variables.description: Stable ID of the outbound campaign.

variables.name: lead_id
variables.notes: Do not use secret/internal auth tokens.

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: Verified human contact name used for personal address. Leave blank if unknown.
variables.notes: Never invent a person name from the restaurant name.

variables.name: customer_salutation
variables.description: Optional verified salutation or preferred form of address.
variables.notes: Leave blank if not verified.

variables.name: website_language
variables.notes: Observation about website; not automatically the person's preferred spoken language.

variables.name: customer_language
variables.description: Language the agent should use for the call.
variables.notes: Use a known/approved language or campaign default.

variables.name: restaurant_name
variables.description: Official/display name of the restaurant or business.

variables.name: customer_role
variables.description: Role of the contacted person if known.
variables.notes: Leave blank if unknown.

variables.name: restaurant_category
variables.description: Business category, e.g. restaurant, cafe, bar.

variables.name: cuisine_type
variables.notes: Do not infer from names alone.

variables.name: prospect_company
variables.description: Alias for restaurant_name used by the current compiler contract.
variables.notes: Set equal to restaurant_name.

variables.name: prospect_role
variables.description: Alias for customer_role used by current build.
variables.notes: Set equal to customer_role when known.

variables.name: prospect_locale
variables.description: Alias for customer_locale used by current build.
variables.notes: Set equal to customer_locale.

variables.name: website_role
variables.description: Business role assigned to the website for this campaign.
variables.example: Auffindbarkeit, Speisekarte, Kontakt und direkter Reservierungsweg
variables.notes: Campaign-controlled context, not a measured fact about a specific restaurant.

variables.name: primary_customer_type
variables.description: Customer/business context used by the conversation policy.

variables.name: lead_source_current
variables.notes: Must be externally governed.

variables.name: compliance_status
variables.notes: Allowed values per skill: APPROVED, BLOCKED, LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Only APPROVED rows may proceed to live calling.

variables.name: do_not_contact
variables.notes: If true, the row must not be called.

variables.name: contact_type
variables.notes: Current campaign contract is B2B.

variables.name: ai_disclosure_required
variables.description: Whether explicit AI disclosure is required by campaign policy.
variables.notes: Pixelkiez architecture adopts explicit AI disclosure.

variables.name: recording_status
variables.notes: Use OFF, APPROVED, or LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED according to external approval.

variables.name: audit_id
variables.description: ID of the validated restaurant website audit packet.

variables.name: audit_method_scope
variables.description: Short semicolon-separated description of what was actually checked.
variables.notes: Do not imply analytics/ranking checks that were not performed.

variables.name: audit_overall_score
variables.description: Overall score only when an approved score method was used.
variables.notes: Leave blank if score method not approved/not used.

variables.name: audit_score_scale
variables.notes: Leave blank if no approved score.

variables.name: audit_score_status
variables.notes: Use approved contract values, e.g. APPROVED_INTERNAL / NOT_USED.

variables.name: audit_limitations
variables.example: Keine Analytics; keine Search Console; keine Conversiondaten
variables.notes: Important guardrail against overclaiming.

variables.name: audit_strength_1_observation
variables.description: One positive verified observation to keep the call balanced when useful.
variables.example: Oeffnungszeiten und Adresse sind direkt sichtbar.

variables.name: audit_strength_1_evidence_pointer
variables.description: Evidence pointer for the positive observation.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_evidence_class
variables.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_observation
variables.example: Reservierungsweg ist im ersten sichtbaren Bereich nicht direkt erkennbar.
variables.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_evidence_pointer
variables.description: Where the evidence for hook 1 can be found.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_spoken
variables.example: Bei unserem Website-Check ist uns aufgefallen, dass der Reservierungsweg nicht direkt sichtbar ist. Ist das fuer Sie relevant?
variables.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_possible_relevance
variables.example: Direkte Reservierungswege koennen relevant sein, wenn eigene Reservierungen fuer den Betrieb wichtig sind.
variables.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_prohibited_claims
variables.description: Pipe-separated claims the agent must not make for hook 1.
variables.example: Dadurch verlieren Sie Reservierungen|Das kostet Sie Umsatz
variables.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

variables.name: audit_hook_1_selector_score
variables.description: Internal hook selector score for hook 1.
variables.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_evidence_class
variables.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_observation
variables.example: Speisekarte ist nur als PDF verlinkt.
variables.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_evidence_pointer
variables.description: Where the evidence for hook 2 can be found.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_spoken
variables.example: Ein zweiter Punkt betrifft die Speisekarte: Sie ist in unserem Check nur als PDF verlinkt. Waere eine direkt lesbare Web-Speisekarte fuer Sie relevant?
variables.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_possible_relevance
variables.example: Direkt lesbare Menues koennen fuer mobile Nutzung und maschinelle Lesbarkeit relevant sein.
variables.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_prohibited_claims
variables.description: Pipe-separated claims the agent must not make for hook 2.
variables.example: Google kann Ihr PDF nicht lesen|Sie ranken deshalb schlechter
variables.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

variables.name: audit_hook_2_selector_score
variables.description: Internal hook selector score for hook 2.
variables.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_id
variables.notes: Hook 1 primary; hook 2 optional; hook 3 only for genuine prospect demand.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_evidence_class
variables.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_observation
variables.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_evidence_pointer
variables.description: Where the evidence for hook 3 can be found.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_spoken
variables.example: Wir haben die lokale Sichtbarkeit nicht belastbar gemessen. Waere das grundsaetzlich ein Thema fuer Sie?
variables.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_possible_relevance
variables.example: Lokale Auffindbarkeit kann fuer Restaurants relevant sein, wurde hier aber nicht gemessen.
variables.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_prohibited_claims
variables.description: Pipe-separated claims the agent must not make for hook 3.
variables.example: Sie werden bei Google schlecht gefunden|ChatGPT empfiehlt Ihre Konkurrenz
variables.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

variables.name: audit_hook_3_selector_score
variables.description: Internal hook selector score for hook 3.
variables.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

variables.name: call_stage
variables.description: Initial state of the call state machine.
variables.notes: Can be updated by ElevenLabs Update State tool.

variables.name: interest_level
variables.notes: Update during conversation.

variables.name: confirmed_relevance
variables.description: Whether prospect has confirmed relevance of the discussed topic.
variables.notes: Update during conversation.

variables.name: meeting_readiness
variables.notes: Do not derive from turn count.

variables.name: preferred_followup_time
variables.description: Known/preferred callback time if already available.
variables.notes: Usually blank initially; may be set in-call.

variables.name: opt_out
variables.notes: Set true immediately after hard no/do-not-call.

variables.name: needs_human
variables.notes: Update during conversation.

variables.name: meeting_offer
variables.description: Approved label for the human handoff/meeting offer.
variables.notes: Do not promise a booked meeting without tool success.

variables.name: consultant_id
variables.notes: Leave blank until approved.

variables.name: meeting_duration_minutes
variables.notes: Leave blank until approved.
